title: Multi-omics–based characterization of machine-perfused extended-criteria donor (ECD) kidneys to optimize graft allocation and identify potential therapeutic targets
summary:
Kidney transplantation is often the best treatment for people with end-stage kidney failure. Because donor organs are scarce, more kidneys from “extended-criteria donors” (ECD) are used, but it is often difficult to judge organ quality during allocation because only limited donor information is available.

From January 2026, ECD kidneys in Germany will routinely be preserved with hypothermic machine perfusion (HMP), creating a controlled setting outside the body to study the organ before transplantation. In this prospective, non-interventional study, we will analyze samples collected during routine HMP (perfusate at the end of perfusion) and from the standard pre-implantation baseline biopsy, using multi-omics methods (metabolomics/proteomics and transcriptomics). We will link these results—pseudonymized—to routine clinical data and outcomes (e.g., delayed graft function and 12-month graft performance).

The goal is to find biomarker patterns that help distinguish better from higher-risk ECD kidneys, supporting more objective organ assessment and improved allocation in the future.

interventions.name:
Observational cohorts (primary/comparator cohorts)
Cohort 1 – HMP/omics cohort (primary):
Recipients of a deceased-donor extended-criteria donor (ECD) kidney preserved by hypothermic machine perfusion (HMP).
→ This cohort undergoes multi-omics analyses (perfusate: metabolomics/proteomics; pre-imp

Cohort 2 – Non-HMP cohort (optional, prospective):
Recipients of a deceased-donor ECD kidney without HMP preservation, e.g. not machine-perfused due to logistical/technical reasons, or imported organs without HMP.
→ No multi-omics analyses; clinical outcome data are collected for contextualization

Cohort 3 – Historical non-HMP cohort (optional, retrospective):
Recipients of a deceased-donor ECD kidney without HMP from the predefined time period (e.g., 01/2020–18/01/2026).
→ Retrospective clinical data analysis for contextualization/estimation of outcome rates.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
-Kidney transplantation of a deceased-donor extended-criteria donor (ECD) kidney at the study center. ECD is defined in accordance with the German Medical Association guideline as donor age >60 years, or donor age 50–59 years plus at least two of the following: cerebrovascular cause of death, arterial hypertension, serum creatinine ≥1.5 mg/dL (≥132 µmol/L)
-Membership in one of the following groups:
HMP cohort: ECD kidney preserved using hypothermic machine perfusion (multi-omics analyses planned).
Comparator cohort (optional): ECD kidney without HMP (not machine-perfused for logistical/technical reasons or imported organ without HMP) and/or a historical ECD cohort (clinical data analysis only)
Exclusion criteria:
-Non-evaluable/missing data (e.g., missing clinical outcome data and/or missing sample/omics data required for the respective analyses)
